progress-linear._comment: overflow/position/width below are NOT read by OrigamProgressLinear.vue — its SCSS hardcodes these as SCSS literals matching the same values, so they are kept but dormant. This block used to also have a flat `background: transparent` leaf here; it collided in NAME with the `__background` BEM child the component actually reads (issue #508, case 3) and was itself dormant (the component hardcodes `background: transparent` as a literal, never reading this var), so it was removed rather than renamed. `loader` was never declared at all — added below.

indeterminate-duration.$description: Duration of the indeterminate bar animation. Not tokenised as motion.duration.* because it is SVG/CSS-animation-specific and differs from UI motion tokens.

background._comment: Background track (buffer / remaining zone) — .origam-progress__background. Bare child key (no hyphen), so the plain heuristic already resolves it; no $child marker needed.

color.$description: Inherits color from the component's color prop via useTextColor (backgroundColorClasses).

loader._comment: .origam-progress__loader — read with no fallback other than the CSS keyword `inherit` prior to this token existing.

opacity.$description: Buffer stream indicator opacity. No matching primitive token (available: opacity.26, opacity.32). Kept as literal 0.3 pending addition of opacity.30 to the primitive tier.
